comparison.objective: Erect a folding produce crate and latch all four sprung corners.
comparison.physical_skill: Ordered wall articulation, bimanual bracing and pulling through spring catches, followed by release.
comparison.success_condition: Four corners latched, walls vertical, base flat, crate still, and both grippers clear.
comparison.reason: This tests multibody erection and four mechanical latches, not precision screw/collar adjustment or dynamic stop commissioning.
